reviews_5s: These are GORGEOUS!! I didn’t expect them to be this good and the price was reasonable. They are so delicate and girly. I like that they are just floral and don’t really have the Asian choinoiserie look. Printed well and the gold metallic is painted nicely. Love the shape of the saucers and the handle on the cup feels nice to hold. The little spoons are a delightful extra…I’ll hand wash the spoons and dry immediately to keep them nice. The cups , for sone reason, look small in my pics, but rest assured they’re normal teacup size. I can’t wait to put a tea party together using these! Packed very well, not a chip or break. Don’t even hesitate to buy. I love these so much I plan to buy another pattern from this company!They are SO pretty. The handle design makes them look like a vintage item and much more expensive than other teacups I have purchased here. I am very picky since I embellish and resell teacups and these are amazing. They are on the smaller side, not a full 8 ounces, which makes them suitable for children as well. All other blue and gold floral cups I found here were of much lower quality.Purchased as a gift for my mother in law’s 80th birthday party next week. She is a tea drinker and collects teacups and saucers. Created a vignette with a serving tray that was decorated with a teacup and saucer that match this set. Added some fancy tea, Godiva chocolates, a set of taper candles, flowers and a photo of her and her best friend who has now passed. Wrapped everything up in a cellophane bag. She is very difficult to please so I hope she likes it.I wanted a quality cup and saucer for my teapot and this is more than I could have asked for. If you know anyone who loves tea, this would be the perfect gift. And the small, gold spoon that comes with the cup and saucer is divine.Absolutely love this bone china teacup set! The cups are lightweight yet sturdy, with a beautiful, classic design that adds a touch of elegance to my tea time. The colors are vibrant and the finish has a nice, smooth feel. Highly recommend!This cup is beautiful! The design just makes me happy! The quality is excellent. The blue is a rich color. It arrived on time and we'll packed.So beautiful. Love it so muchBeautiful Set!Beautiful teacup. I want to use it during my Bible study time. It's perfect.This cup is beautifully designed and will packed. My daughter loves using this cup for her tea.
